We don't build guitars for a market segment. We build them for people.

Nearly a decade at the bench and a lifetime around music. Every House of Jubal guitar begins with how you play and what you want it to say — and you'll know exactly who is building it.

Three shapes.

II. The Redemption Series

Look again.

Where others see something imperfect, overlooked or disposable, we look again. There may still be beauty written into it.

We don't manufacture imperfections. We don't invent a story. We work with the story already there.

Every Redemption guitar is one of one. It exists only when the right material is found — so there's no waitlist to join, just a conversation to start.

IV. Wooden pickup covers

A little House of Jubal for the guitar you already love.

Hand-made humbucker covers in solid wood, set in polished metal. The easiest way to put real grain under your strings without commissioning a whole guitar.

VI. How a commission works

Listen first.
Then build.

No pressure toward upgrades, no hidden costs, and delays told early — not hidden.

  1. i.

    Inquiry

    Your playing, your taste, your practical needs, and the story you want the guitar to carry.

  2. ii.

    Fit conversation

    An honest talk about whether we're right for each other — and Main Line or Redemption.

  3. iii.

    Concept & spec

    Model, woods, hardware, electronics and finish agreed — with the tradeoffs explained.

  4. iv.

    The build

    A deposit reserves your slot. You'll hear about the moments that matter, not every sanding pass.

  5. v.

    Delivery

    Handed over with a sense of occasion — then a follow-up once it's been played in.
